title: Searching tracked with trailing spaces lists untracked parts plus normal matches on tracked
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Active tab of /parts/inventory, Supply All, no other filter, DevTools Network open. Data: QAPL-U1, QAPL-U2 (untracked, active). Setup as (a): a tracked part "QA-S6-TRK-{run}" with description "QA tracked clamp" (switch left on); note every other active untracked part at the location (rows with is_tracked false in GET /api/inventory/parts?status=active). Setup as (a): New Inventory Part, Description "QA S6 inactive untracked", Part Number "QA-S6-INU-{run}", Category, Cost, switch "Track quantities and cost of goods" off, Save; reopen it, pick Part Status Inactive (radio_part_status_inactive), Save, then Deactivate in "Deactivate part?" (toast "Part deactivated.").
custom_steps:
1. Type tracked followed by two spaces ("tracked ") in the Inventory search and wait for the list to refresh (750 ms debounce).
  2. Read the GET /api/inventory/parts request and response for that search in the Network tab.
  3. Replace the text with "TRACKED " (capitals, two trailing spaces).
  4. Replace the text with "tracke" (one letter short).
  5. Clear the search.
custom_expected:
1. The list shows QAPL-U1, QAPL-U2 and every other noted active untracked part, each with "Not Tracked", plus QA-S6-TRK-{run} (its description contains "tracked"); no other tracked part and not the inactive QA-S6-INU-{run}.
  2. 200; the rows are exactly the screen's set: every row with is_tracked false plus the tracked rows whose number, description or tags contain "tracked"; every row has is_active true.
  3. The same set as step 1 (case and outer spaces do not matter).
  4. Only ordinary matches (QA-S6-TRK-{run}); no untracked part unless its own fields contain "tracke" (known mismatch: only the exact words search on tracking).
  5. The full Active list returns.
